summary: search_index default --variables use Ignition's real pagedQuery field names pageNumber/pageSize, not page/perPage.
reason: The HAR-derived spec baked guessed pagination field names into the first generate; live Ignition pagedQuery requires pageNumber/pageSize (verified against a live-tested internal GraphQL reference). A regen from the corrected spec reproduces this automatically.
validated_outcome: Live search-index pages 2+ return distinct result pages instead of repeating page 1.
